Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite, ONE isolated COMPLETE SMALL KIOSK BUILDING WITH ROOF REMOVED, from the approved reference. Image 1 is approved concept; faithfully match its main left kiosk. Camera orthographic nearly overhead, axis-aligned vertical and horizontal footprint edges, visible SOUTH front surfaces, same game 2.5D painted style. Entire object occupies most canvas, transparent background and transparent floor area inside U-shaped back and side walls, NO ground plane, no characters, no labels outside object, no reference board.
Building footprint width:depth approximately 1.5:1. Warm ivory plaster back/side shell with slim muted sage metal edging; interior back zone fitted with honey-brown storage shelves, boxed goods, bottled drinks, towels, a small green staff door on right. Main rectangular roof removed to show stocked storage interior. South storefront should be the faithful approved frontage: narrow green corrugated canopy stretching full width, aged ivory sign "小卖铺" centred on fascia, warm wooden sales counter with dark register and ledger to left, small packets to right. Two slim timber display cabinets at either end hold everyday goods. Aperture behind counter must be EMPTY and TRANSPARENT in centre, with room for a separate adult vendor sprite head and torso beneath sign, no prepainted vendor. Counter and canopy are part of one coherent simple store facade, not detached furniture; no lower entrance opening, customers buy through counter. Include subtle lamp below canopy. Behind service aperture painted stocked shelf portions toward either side are okay but central window must remain transparent. Show shell top trim as metal/ivory, NEVER stone prison coping. Match reference palette and crisp small game-readable forms; no bloom, no excessive rust, no neon, no pavement, no shopper, no shadow extending outside silhouette. Preserve a broad horizontal frontage, sidewalls extend north rather than diagonal. Use actual alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. One production isolated roof sprite for the approved small campus kiosk. Reference image 1 defines the design. A rectangular shallow lean-to roof of muted sage-green corrugated metal, wide horizontal rectangle with width:depth ratio 1.8:1. Camera straight overhead orthographic aligned to screen axes, zero diagonal rotation. Slim green-gray metal edging and a neat shallow gutter at south edge. Subtle age and sparse small rust scratches, no stone edging. ONE modest square metal roof vent in upper-right quarter and a narrow drain/pipe near rear edge. Match approved panel "屋顶外观", but provide ONLY the complete rectangular main roof without storefront, canopy, sign, walls, floor, scenery or characters. A slim roof front fascia may be visible along bottom edge. Sharp painted 2.5D game illustration with restrained dark outlines, neutral daylight, no heavy shadow outside object. True transparent alpha outside roof; roof surface fully opaque, no holes. Fill most of canvas with the roof, keep entire object within margins. No board, no typography, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game character sprite for the shopkeeper in the approved reference kiosk. One single middle-aged Chinese man, short black hair, approachable calm expression, blue-gray plain work jacket with rolled sleeves over a simple light shirt. He faces SOUTH toward viewer from nearly overhead 2.5D camera, centered, upper body from crown to waist ONLY; he is standing behind a sales counter which will be rendered separately. Both hands resting forward at waist level, no counter, no objects in hands, no legs. Match the warm hand-painted cartoon game character style of this project, readable dark outline, slightly enlarged head, restrained proportions, detailed matte cloth, no photo realism. Image1 seller in right-top sales-window panel is design reference. Actual alpha transparency all around character. No building, no props, no labels, no heavy shadow, no background. Fill canvas with this one bust leaving clean margins.
